invariants.claim: Successful payment accounting has paidPrice <= msg.value and excess = msg.value-paidPrice; positive excess must transfer successfully before DrawRequested.
The adapter pays its own second wrapper quote and returns that quote as paidPrice.
The shared guard remains entered during wrapper payment and excess refund.

calls.propagates: Shared fixed-slot exclusion for guarded functions throughout the body; entry predicate rejects ENTERED and accepts an initial zero slot (ReentrancyGuard.sol L69-L73, L88-L117).
Returns fixed guard slot and exact uint256 storage alias (ReentrancyGuard.sol L35-L37, L116-L118; StorageSlot.sol L93-L97).
Returns only with expected Active equality, otherwise InvalidStatus (Raffle.sol L241, L573-L575).
Returns uint256(endTime)+2 days on its only path (Raffle.sol L458-L460; RaffleConstants.sol L32-L33).
Forwards wrapper native quote for callbackGasLimit and one word; no independent validation (Raffle.sol L436-L438).

Called once before lifecycle mutation and once inside native adapter; returned quote controls funding and payment, but implementation is absent (Raffle.sol L249-L250, L436-L438; consumer base L82; wrapper interface L23-L33).
Encodes V1 selector and nativePayment:true struct (Raffle.sol L255; client L7-L10, L22-L26).
Requotes, pays exactly the quote, returns external request ID and quoted price; reverts propagate and request-ID semantics remain external assumptions (consumer base L76-L88).

Receives quoted value, 300000 callback gas, 30 confirmations, one word and native encoding; must supply meaningful request ID and asynchronous service (consumer base L84-L87; RaffleConstants.sol L38-L42; interface L67-L79).
Positive excess transfer must return success; arbitrary recipient behavior and reentry are possible, with guarded entry blocked (Raffle.sol L263-L269; ReentrancyGuard.sol L69-L73, L88-L100).
Returns stored request time plus two days if nonzero, otherwise default zero; value is emitted (Raffle.sol L272, L463-L465; RaffleConstants.sol L35-L36).
